sentences.en: Today, the story of the new rituals that we create in a crisis.
sentences.zh: 今天，讲述的是我们在危机中创造的新仪式的故事。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月29日，星期二。

sentences.en: Catherine, I wonder if you can tell me a little bit about what you've been watching from your home in Toronto ever since the pandemic started hitting North America.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳，我想知道，自从疫情开始席卷北美以来，你在多伦多的家中观察到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I have written a lot about death over the years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，多年来我写过很多关于死亡的文章。

sentences.en: It's one of those things that, for whatever reason, it interests me and I keep coming back to it.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，这是我感兴趣的事情之一，我总是会回过头来关注它。

sentences.en: So because I've always been interested in death and written about death, I've been looking through the birth and death notices.
sentences.zh: 因为我一直对死亡感兴趣并撰写相关文章，所以我一直在翻看出生和死亡启事。

sentences.en: And the obits have been really interesting because something that I'd never seen before, at the bottom, you know, whether or not the person had died of COVID, you know, many of
sentences.zh: 讣告真的很有趣，因为我以前从未见过这种情况，在底部，你知道，无论那个人是否死于新冠，你知道，他们中的许多

sentences.en: them have died just of old age or of cancer or whatever else.
sentences.zh: 人只是死于年老、癌症或其他原因。

sentences.en: But at the bottom, I started to highlight these statements that seem to repeat themselves over and over again, which were things
sentences.zh: 但在底部，我开始注意到这些似乎反复出现的声明，内容是

sentences.en: like, though we cannot celebrate her life now, a happier time will come when we can all come together,
sentences.zh: 比如，虽然我们现在无法庆祝她的一生，但未来会有更快乐的时光，届时我们都能聚在一起，

sentences.en: or a celebration of her life will be celebrated when it's safe for us to be together.
sentences.zh: 或者，当我们可以安全地聚在一起时，我们将为她举行生命庆典。

sentences.en: We will get together when we're allowed to get together.
sentences.zh: 等我们被允许聚会时，我们就会聚在一起。

sentences.en: And so that planted a seed of like a thought in me, like the public part of mourning is ritualized in our society by coming together.
sentences.zh: 这在我心中埋下了一颗种子，就像是说，在我们社会中，哀悼的公共部分是通过聚会来仪式化的。

sentences.en: We come together and we acknowledge the passing and we have a sense that this is real and we are grieving together.
sentences.zh: 我们聚在一起，承认逝者的离去，我们感到这是真实的，我们正在共同哀悼。

sentences.en: And if this isn't happening, or we're delaying this, like, what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 如果这一切没有发生，或者我们推迟了它，那意味着什么？

sentences.en: How are people coping without that ritual?
sentences.zh: 人们在没有这种仪式的情况下是如何应对的？

sentences.en: Is anyone trying to do this differently?
sentences.zh: 有人在尝试用不同的方式做这件事吗？

sentences.en: So then I found kind of the perfect person for this.
sentences.zh: 于是我找到了最适合谈论这个话题的人。

sentences.en: Who did you find?
sentences.zh: 你找到了谁？

sentences.en: Can you see us on your computer screen or no?
sentences.zh: 你能在电脑屏幕上看到我们吗？

sentences.en: No, I'm sitting,
sentences.zh: 不，我坐着，

sentences.en: I'm talking on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我正在用手机通话。

sentences.en: I've got my wig on straight, but it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 我的假发戴得很正，但这不重要。

sentences.en: Oh, I really wish we could see you then, in that case.
sentences.zh: 噢，那样的话，我真希望我们能见到你。

sentences.en: His name is Wayne Irwin.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫韦恩·欧文。

sentences.en: He's 75.
sentences.zh: 他今年75岁。

sentences.en: He's a retired minister at a church in Canada called the United
sentences.zh: 他是加拿大一家名为加拿大联合教会的退休牧师。

sentences.en: Church of Canada.
sentences.zh: 加拿大联合教会。

sentences.en: It's kind of the preeminent Protestant church here.
sentences.zh: 这算是这里最杰出的新教教会了。

sentences.en: Can you tell me, like, why you think funerals are important?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我，你为什么认为葬礼很重要吗？

sentences.en: The funeral is not for the person who died.
sentences.zh: 葬礼不是为死者举办的。

sentences.en: The funeral is for the person who remained.
sentences.zh: 葬礼是为活着的人举办的。

sentences.en: He was a minister for more than 40 years, meaning that he presided over hundreds of funerals.
sentences.zh: 他做了40多年的牧师，这意味着他主持过数百场葬礼。

sentences.en: He's sort of a master of ceremonies at a funeral.
sentences.zh: 他算是葬礼上的司仪大师。

sentences.en: He knows how they work.
sentences.zh: 他知道葬礼是如何运作的。

sentences.en: He knows the importance of the ritual.
sentences.zh: 他知道仪式的重要性。

sentences.en: And they are a marker for us.
sentences.zh: 它们是我们生命中的一个标记。

sentences.en: They're like a life passage moment that we can remember, okay, the person died, we did that thing.
sentences.zh: 它们就像一个人生阶段的时刻，我们可以记住，好吧，那个人去世了，我们做了那件事。

sentences.en: So now we're in a world after that.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们处于那之后的世界里。

sentences.en: But in the 10 years since he retired, he's also been helping churches go online.
sentences.zh: 但在他退休后的10年里，他一直在帮助教会实现线上化。

sentences.en: So he was kind of like the perfect person to move from a funeral in a building into an online funeral.
sentences.zh: 所以他就像是把葬礼从实体建筑转移到线上葬礼的完美人选。

sentences.en: And then something tragic happened in his personal life, and he lost someone very close to him.
sentences.zh: 然后他的个人生活中发生了一些悲剧，他失去了非常亲近的人。

sentences.en: Fleur Amé.
sentences.zh: 弗洛拉·梅。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: My colleague Catherine Porter on the changing way that we're grieving in the era of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 我的同事凯瑟琳·波特将讲述我们在新冠时代哀悼方式的转变。

sentences.en: It's Friday, April 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月24日，星期五。

sentences.en: Can we just talk a little bit?
sentences.zh: 我们可以聊聊吗？

sentences.en: Can we go over your plans, but also just talk a little bit about Flora and about this time for you, Wayne?
sentences.zh: 我们可以谈谈你的计划，但也聊聊弗洛拉，以及这段时间对你来说意味着什么，韦恩？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yes, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: But I, you know, I tend to, you know, the older you get, one story leads to another.
sentences.zh: 但我，你知道，我倾向于，你知道，年纪越大，一个故事就会引出另一个故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, but that's the beauty of being old and also of hearing stories, right?
sentences.zh: 是啊，但这就是变老和听故事的魅力所在，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, very often, very often I ask a question and it's a wrong question and you'll start answering it and you'll realize what a better question was.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很多时候，我问了一个问题，结果发现是个错误的问题，当你开始回答时，你会意识到什么才是更好的问题。

sentences.en: So tell me a bit about your love story, will you?
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我讲讲你们的爱情故事吧，好吗？

sentences.en: Our love story?
sentences.zh: 我们的爱情故事？

sentences.en: Oh, geez, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪，我不知道。

sentences.en: That's a complicated thing.
sentences.zh: 那是一件复杂的事情。

sentences.en: Flora and I knew each other for many, many years in church work and in committees and all of that.
sentences.zh: 弗洛拉和我认识很多很多年了，是在教会工作和委员会活动中认识的。

sentences.en: And we were involved in a ministry where we taught prayer and meditation and helped churches across the country with their prayer programming and all of that.
sentences.zh: 我们参与了一个事工，在那里我们教授祈祷和冥想，并帮助全国各地的教会进行祈祷规划等等。

sentences.en: They met way back in the early 70s.
sentences.zh: 他们早在70年代初就认识了。

sentences.en: He was married and she, I believe, was either married or recently divorced, but soon to get divorced.
sentences.zh: 他当时已婚，而我相信她当时要么已婚，要么刚离婚，但很快就要离婚了。

sentences.en: And Wayne tells this story about going to a church music workshop with a youth group.
sentences.zh: 韦恩讲过一个故事，说他带着一个青年小组去参加教会音乐研讨会。

sentences.en: And at lunch, holding his cafeteria tray, scanning the room, looking for a place to set it down and eat.
sentences.zh: 午餐时，他端着食堂的餐盘，扫视着房间，寻找放餐盘吃饭的地方。

sentences.en: There was a space next to this short, very small, brown-eyed woman.
sentences.zh: 那个矮个子、非常娇小、有着棕色眼睛的女人旁边有一个空位。

sentences.en: I went over, I'll sit with that person, went around and sat down.
sentences.zh: 我走过去，心想我就坐在那个人旁边，于是绕过去坐下了。

sentences.en: It was Flora.
sentences.zh: 那是弗洛拉。

sentences.en: It was her, Flora May.
sentences.zh: 就是她，弗洛拉·梅。

sentences.en: That was how we met, both of us introverts.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这样认识的，我们俩都是内向的人。

sentences.en: She grew up not far from where I'm talking to you in the countryside outside of Toronto.
sentences.zh: 她长大的地方离我现在跟你说话的地方不远，在多伦多郊外的乡村。

sentences.en: She was a farm girl.
sentences.zh: 她是个农家女孩。

sentences.en: In fact, one of her friends told me that, you know, before she went to high school every morning, she had to collect the eggs from more than 300 hens.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她的一个朋友告诉我，你知道，她每天早上上高中之前，都必须从300多只母鸡那里收集鸡蛋。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: What was she like as a person?
sentences.zh: 她是个什么样的人？

sentences.en: Well, she was an angel and a saint all wrapped into one because she was the sweetest and most
sentences.zh: 嗯，她是一个天使和圣人的结合体，因为她是最甜美、最

sentences.en: tremendously deep.
sentences.zh: 极其深沉的人。

sentences.en: And so we had deep, deep conversations in theology and philosophy together.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在一起进行过非常深刻的神学和哲学对话。

sentences.en: You know, very quickly, like within about two years, they started collaborating.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很快，大约两年内，他们就开始合作了。

sentences.en: She had really great musical skills, but also was a poet and wrote a lot.
sentences.zh: 她有非常棒的音乐天赋，同时也是一位诗人，写了很多东西。

sentences.en: She started writing her own stuff way back.
sentences.zh: 她很早以前就开始写自己的东西了。

sentences.en: And she would just, that's something she would do when she was sitting somewhere.
sentences.zh: 她坐在某处时经常会做这件事。

sentences.en: She'd often put some words together.
sentences.zh: 她经常会把一些词句组合在一起。

sentences.en: And so they started collaborating, doing, you know, new hymns together and writing songs.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始合作，你知道，一起创作新的赞美诗和歌曲。

sentences.en: He would put her lyrics to music.
sentences.zh: 他会为她的歌词谱曲。

sentences.en: And over time, both of them became single parents.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们俩都成了单亲父母。

sentences.en: And about 20 years ago, he says, when they were both single at that point, they had an awakening
sentences.zh: 大约20年前，他说，当他们当时都是单身时，他们有了一种觉醒，

sentences.en: that they both sort of looked at each other and realized that they were in love and they had been in love.
sentences.zh: 他们俩看着对方，意识到他们相爱了，而且一直都相爱着。

sentences.en: By that point, Flora was in her 70s.
sentences.zh: 那时，弗洛拉已经70多岁了。

sentences.en: And when he did propose, he was substantially younger than her, 15 years.
sentences.zh: 当他求婚时，他比她年轻得多，小了15岁。

sentences.en: And he said she laughed hysterically because she couldn't envision being married to him when he was so much younger than her.
sentences.zh: 他说她笑得歇斯底里，因为她无法想象在比他年轻这么多的情况下嫁给他。

sentences.en: So he said, well, I took the proposal back and said, well, maybe I'll, we'll do this at another time when it's not so uproariously funny to you.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，好吧，我收回了求婚，说，也许，我们可以在另一个时候再做这件事，当它对你来说不再那么好笑的时候。

sentences.en: And he proposed again with a crossword puzzle.
sentences.zh: 后来他用填字游戏再次求婚。

sentences.en: And she literally went to her children and asked for permission, basically, to get married again and for advice.
sentences.zh: 她真的去问了她的孩子们，基本上是请求再次结婚的许可并征求建议。

sentences.en: And she agreed they got married and they had lived this wonderful second life together.
sentences.zh: 她同意了，他们结婚了，并一起度过了这段美好的第二人生。

sentences.en: And do you have a favorite memory of her?
sentences.zh: 你对她有什么最喜欢的记忆吗？

sentences.en: I guess my most favorite memory is the moment I saw her on our wedding day for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我想我最喜欢的记忆是在我们婚礼那天第一次见到她的那一刻。

sentences.en: She literally took my breath away.
sentences.zh: 她真的让我屏住了呼吸。

sentences.en: Literally.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: I gasped.
sentences.zh: 我倒吸了一口凉气。

sentences.en: You know, it was that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: Anyway, that's my favorite memory.
sentences.zh: 总之，那是我最喜欢的记忆。

sentences.en: But yes, we did all of England and Scotland and Wales and Ireland.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，我们游遍了整个英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和爱尔兰。

sentences.en: So we did all that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们做了所有这些。

sentences.en: And then we went through the Panama Canal and did all of that.
sentences.zh: 然后我们穿过了巴拿马运河，做了所有那些事。

sentences.en: And then they traveled up to Alaska.
sentences.zh: 然后他们去了阿拉斯加。

sentences.en: They walked up Mount Sinai in the middle of the night so that we could be on top at sunrise.
sentences.zh: 他们在半夜爬上西奈山，这样我们就能在日出时到达山顶。

sentences.en: And so we've done things like that, you know, together.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一起做过这样的事情，你知道。

sentences.en: They went to Antarctica when she was in her 80s, late 80s.
sentences.zh: 她在80多岁，快90岁的时候去了南极洲。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, there's not very many people who've been to Antarctica.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，去过南极洲的人并不多。

sentences.en: So when you say we've done things like that, we went to, you know, we went to the moon, you know, done those things.
sentences.zh: 所以当你提到我们做过这样的事情时，我们去了，你知道，我们去了月球，你知道，做过那些事情。

sentences.en: You know, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你知道。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: And up until last summer, they were traveling in Europe together.
sentences.zh: 直到去年夏天，他们还在一起在欧洲旅行。

sentences.en: And it wasn't until then that he says that she sat up in bed one night in Rome and said, I can't breathe.
sentences.zh: 直到那时，他说她有一天晚上在罗马坐在床上说，我喘不过气来。

sentences.en: She was living with, I think I told you, Catherine, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, which was only the last six months that the symptoms began to appear.
sentences.zh: 她患有，我想我告诉过你，凯瑟琳，特发性肺纤维化，症状出现仅仅是最后六个月的事。

sentences.en: And slowly their world started to get smaller and smaller.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，他们的世界开始变得越来越小。

sentences.en: There were times when she would say, I'm so scared, I'm so scared.
sentences.zh: 有时她会说，我好害怕，我好害怕。

sentences.en: And it was because she was oxygen starved.
sentences.zh: 那是因为她缺氧。

sentences.en: It was like, you know, someone who's drowning.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，溺水的人一样。

sentences.en: And I was feeling great angst, wanting to somehow help her not be scared.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常焦虑，想方设法帮助她不再害怕。

sentences.en: And all I could do is get the oxygen on and things like that.
sentences.zh: 我能做的就是给她戴上氧气面罩之类的东西。

sentences.en: By March, the world around her is worried about COVID.
sentences.zh: 到了三月，她周围的世界都在担心新冠病毒。

sentences.en: And she became very worried that she would get this and it would be an awful death, as did her husband.
sentences.zh: 她非常担心自己会感染这种病毒，那将是一种可怕的死亡，她的丈夫也一样。

sentences.en: So, you know, her life that was already smaller became even smaller.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，她原本就已经很小的生活变得更小了。

sentences.en: They stopped taking so many visitors because they were worried about the spread and her getting it.
sentences.zh: 他们停止了接待那么多访客，因为他们担心传播以及她被感染。

sentences.en: And they would spend their days mostly together.
sentences.zh: 他们大部分时间都待在一起。

sentences.en: So on, you know, a Sunday and the end of March, they were having a quiet day.
sentences.zh: 所以，在三月底的一个星期天，他们度过了安静的一天。

sentences.en: She had dinner with us.
sentences.zh: 她和我们一起吃了晚饭。

sentences.en: And when I say us, I had a dear friend who's a public health nurse who lives just around the corner.
sentences.zh: 当我提到我们时，我有一位亲爱的朋友，她是住在街角的公共卫生护士。

sentences.en: And we were live streaming the worship from the Sunday up onto the flat screen here.
